items.silhouette: low hexapod body with a domed furnace-shell and an oversized wedge-shaped digging head
items.anatomy: four compact walking legs, two shovel forelimbs, bright bead eyes, and a segmented tail tucked beneath the shell
items.materials: charcoal chitin, cooled basalt plates, and narrow seams of internal orange heat
items.personality: industrious, wary, and ready to brace itself rather than flee
signature_features: shovel forelimbs dusted with volcanic grit
items.pose_instruction: front claws planted wide while one shell vent releases a tiny controlled ember puff
visual_exclusions: open flame covering the entire body

items.silhouette: slender fawn body beneath a tall forked crown of flexible reeds
items.anatomy: small split hooves, long listening ears, short muzzle, and hollow antler stems joined by leaf-like fins
items.materials: water-dark fur, living reed fibers, translucent fin leaves, and clear droplets held by surface tension
items.personality: shy, attentive, and gently curious from a safe distance
signature_features: reed antlers carrying suspended water beads
pale ripple marking around one eye
items.pose_instruction: one forehoof lifted over a small implied ripple while the reed crown bends in a gentle arc

items.silhouette: compact glider with a triangular wing membrane and a long forked weather-vane tail
items.anatomy: large forward eyes, short grasping feet, swept ear feathers, and hollow tail vanes that inflate with air
items.materials: soft slate fur, taut pale flight membrane, and translucent cyan tail vanes
items.personality: bold, restless, and delighted by sudden changes in wind
signature_features: one swept ear feather pointing into the wind
items.pose_instruction: membrane partly spread in a stable landing crouch with the forked tail curling upward

items.silhouette: streamlined seabird body framed by crescent wings and two long ribbon-like tail fins
items.anatomy: short hooked beak, webbed feet tucked close, layered wing feathers, and flexible aquatic tail ribbons
items.materials: pearl-white feathers, glassy blue flight fins, and an aurora sheen restricted to the tail tips
items.personality: serene, precise, and protective of travelers who have lost their way
signature_features: three stepped wave marks on each wing
items.pose_instruction: wings raised in a shallow crescent as if banking, tail ribbons forming one clean S-curve

items.silhouette: heavy low quadruped with a staircase of broad stone scales rising toward the shoulders
items.anatomy: powerful digging paws, blunt snout, small calm eyes, and overlapping back plates that lock into a defensive arch
items.materials: weathered granite scales, packed earthen joints, soft moss, and tiny white alpine flowers
items.personality: patient, dependable, and immovable when sheltering smaller creatures
signature_features: moss eyebrow over the left eye
single flowering sprig growing from the shoulder plate
items.pose_instruction: three-quarter defensive stance with shoulders lowered and the stepped plates clearly separated
